channel.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI
channel.description: A non-AI view of GitHub Trending — a daily digest of open-source tools, libraries, languages, and projects trending right now.

item.title: GitHub Trending, Minus the AI — September 21, 2026
item.description:
Today's 56 trending open-source repositories, with AI-focused projects filtered out. Highlights:

  1. public-apis/public-apis (481,981 ⭐) — A collective list of free APIs
  2. freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp (455,867 ⭐) — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
  3. EbookFoundation/free-programming-books (397,339 ⭐) — :books: Freely available programming books
  4. donnemartin/system-design-primer (371,058 ⭐) — Learn how to design large-scale systems. Prep for the system design interview. Includes Anki flashcards.
  5. nilbuild/developer-roadmap (367,798 ⭐) — Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
  6. vinta/awesome-python (322,034 ⭐) — The definitive list that answers "I want to do X in Python, which tool should I use?"
  7. awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted (320,696 ⭐) — A list of Free Software network services and web applications which can be hosted on your own servers
  8. practical-tutorials/project-based-learning (284,093 ⭐) — Curated list of project-based tutorials
  9. react/react (250,617 ⭐) — The library for web and native user interfaces.
  10. torvalds/linux (249,664 ⭐) — Linux kernel source tree
